property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer performs every transferFrom via external call and returns true (reverting if any sub-call fails).
With a single-element recipient list, C.transfer returns true (and reverts only if the transferFrom sub-call fails).
For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer always returns true (reverting if any transferFrom sub-call fails).
C.transfer reverts whenever the recipient list is empty, regardless of other inputs.
If transfer does not revert, it returns true (it can never return false or another value).
A successful transfer call never moves Ether to c (its balance is unchanged) and does not revert when the token address accepts arbitrary calls.
A transfer call with an empty destination list always reverts.
Calling transfer with a non-empty destination list on a token address that has no code (an EOA) never reverts and returns true.
When the destination and value arrays have different lengths, transfer always reverts (index out of bounds on the shorter array).
C.transfer reverts exactly when _tos is empty, and otherwise returns true after issuing a transferFrom to each destination.
